tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind panels; the app shell background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, tables and cards: the main reading ground.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Sticky table headers, popovers, menus, the nav rail.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Chart canvas and code wells; one step below surface.

tokens.name: row-hover
tokens.usage: Table row under the pointer.

tokens.name: row-selected
tokens.usage: Keyboard-cursor / selected table row; pair with the accent bar.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: table rules, panel edges, dividers. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, checkboxes); holds 3:1 on surface and bg.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers on bg, surface, surface-raised and row-selected.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, column headers, units, timestamps; on bg, surface, surface-raised, row-selected.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary metadata (ISIN, run ids) at 12px+; holds 4.5:1 on surface and bg only.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and controls. Exempt from contrast; never for live data.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Interaction: links, active nav, selected tab, keyboard cursor bar, primary button fill; as text on bg and surface.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind accent text (active filter chip, selected segment).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on an accent fill (primary button).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. Marigold, so it never reads as a selection or a price move; 3:1 on every ground.

tokens.name: up
tokens.usage: Price up, profit, positive change, bullish (Supertrend +1). As text on bg, surface, up-soft. Always with a + sign or ▲.

tokens.name: up-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for up cells and the up candle body in dense heatmaps.

tokens.name: on-up
tokens.usage: Label on a solid up fill.

tokens.name: down
tokens.usage: Price down, loss, negative change, bearish (Supertrend −1). As text on bg, surface, down-soft. Always with a − sign or ▼.

tokens.name: down-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for down cells and loss rows.

tokens.name: on-down
tokens.usage: Label on a solid down fill (the EXIT chip).

tokens.name: exit
tokens.usage: EXIT verdict fill and failed status: an alias of down, the highest urgency.

tokens.name: on-exit
tokens.usage: Label on the EXIT fill.

tokens.name: partial
tokens.usage: PARTIAL verdict fill (T1 reached, book part) and warning marks; as text on bg and surface.

tokens.name: partial-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind warning codes and degraded banners.

tokens.name: on-partial
tokens.usage: Label on the PARTIAL fill.

tokens.name: review
tokens.usage: REVIEW verdict: data or logic unsure, a human must look. Never a sell signal. As text and hatched border on bg and surface.

tokens.name: review-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind REVIEW chips and the hatch stripes.

tokens.name: hold
tokens.usage: HOLD verdict: quiet, nothing to do. An outline chip in ink-muted.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Pipeline and sync status ok / completed.

tokens.name: running
tokens.usage: A pipeline run in progress; animated only in the dot.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines and crosshair guides at rest.

tokens.name: candle-up
tokens.usage: Up candle body and wick (close ≥ open).

tokens.name: candle-down
tokens.usage: Down candle body and wick.

tokens.name: volume-up
tokens.usage: Volume bar on an up session.

tokens.name: volume-down
tokens.usage: Volume bar on a down session.

tokens.name: ema-50
tokens.usage: EMA 50 overlay line, 1.5px.

tokens.name: ema-200
tokens.usage: EMA 200 overlay line, 1.5px.

tokens.name: bb-band
tokens.usage: Bollinger upper/middle/lower, 1px; middle dashed.

tokens.name: kc-band
tokens.usage: Keltner channel, 1px dotted.

tokens.name: macd-line
tokens.usage: MACD line.

tokens.name: macd-signal
tokens.usage: MACD signal line.

tokens.name: level-entry
tokens.usage: Signal/position entry level on the chart and in the level ladder.

tokens.name: level-stop
tokens.usage: Stop-loss level, solid.

tokens.name: level-trail
tokens.usage: Chandelier trailing stop, dashed.

tokens.name: level-target
tokens.usage: T1 and T2 levels, dashed.

tokens.name: marker-demerger
tokens.usage: Demerger ex-date marker: unreliable price cliff ahead.

tokens.name: marker-action
tokens.usage: Dividend, split, bonus, rights ex-date markers.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace
families.cond: "IBM Plex Sans Condensed", "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Supertrend turned bearish on the close.
styles.usage: Default UI and table text. 13px is the base: this is a dense tool.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Symbols in tables, emphasised cells, button labels.

styles.name: label
styles.sample: ENTRY  STOP  RISK %  T1  T2  R:R
styles.usage: Column headers, field labels, chip text. Uppercase; condensed so headers never set column width.

styles.name: num
styles.usage: Every price, quantity and percentage in tables. Right-aligned.

styles.name: num-sm
styles.usage: Secondary numbers: levels in tooltips, counts in chips.

styles.name: num-lg
styles.usage: Last close in the symbol header, stat-tile values.

styles.name: num-xl
styles.usage: Verdict counts on Today. One row of these per screen at most.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Reason and warning codes, strategy keys, API values.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip inner gap, icon-to-text in dense cells.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; cell padding-block.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Compact button padding-block; tag padding-inline.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Table cell padding-inline; control gaps.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Panel padding (dense), toolbar gaps.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Panel padding (default), page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Gap between panels; page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Section breaks on Today.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Tables, chart panes, the nav rail. Data surfaces are square.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Chips, tags, verdicts, kbd.

tokens.name: radius-4
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segmented controls.

tokens.name: radius-6
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, popovers, banners. The largest radius in the system.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots only.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, the row side-panel. Panels on the page use a line border, not a shadow.

tokens.name: row-compact
tokens.usage: Table row, compact density (default for Signals).

tokens.name: row-default
tokens.usage: Table row, default density (Positions, Trades).

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons, chips inside toolbars.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects.

tokens.name: nav-width
tokens.usage: Expanded nav rail.

tokens.name: nav-width-collapsed
tokens.usage: Collapsed nav rail (icons + kbd hints).

tokens.name: topbar
tokens.usage: Top bar with session date and data freshness.
